source_note: Review anchors only. Populate summaries from the organization's licensed copy and approved Statement of Applicability. This file does not reproduce the standard.

requirements.title: Context of the organization
requirements.summary: Document the ISMS context, relevant internal and external issues, interested parties, and scope.

requirements.title: Leadership
requirements.summary: Show leadership commitment, an information security policy, and defined responsibilities and authorities.

requirements.title: Planning
requirements.summary: Address information security risks and opportunities, objectives, and planned changes.

requirements.title: Support
requirements.summary: Provide resources, competence, awareness, communication, and controlled documented information.

requirements.title: Operation
requirements.summary: Plan, implement, and control the processes used to operate the ISMS and manage information security risks.

requirements.title: Performance evaluation
requirements.summary: Define monitoring, measurement, analysis, evaluation, internal audit, and management review activities.

requirements.title: Improvement
requirements.summary: Manage nonconformities, corrective action, and continual improvement of the ISMS.

requirements.title: Annex A organizational controls
requirements.summary: Review the applicable organizational controls selected in the approved Statement of Applicability.

requirements.title: Annex A people controls
requirements.summary: Review the applicable people-related controls selected in the approved Statement of Applicability.

requirements.title: Annex A physical controls
requirements.summary: Review the applicable physical and environmental controls selected in the approved Statement of Applicability.

requirements.title: Annex A technological controls
requirements.summary: Review the applicable technology controls selected in the approved Statement of Applicability.
